text:
## Incident Management  
**Incident = Unplanned event causing actual loss or regulatory breach**
name: Chunk 18/32

raw_entities.name: Incident Management Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the identification, classification, and management of unplanned events that cause actual loss or regulatory breach. The policy establishes the framework for incident response and reporting obligations.
context: Incident = Unplanned event causing actual loss or regulatory breach

raw_entities.name: Unplanned Event
raw_entities.description: An unplanned event that causes actual loss or regulatory breach, forming the basis for incident classification and management under this policy.
context: Incident = Unplanned event causing actual loss or regulatory breach

raw_entities.name: Actual Loss
raw_entities.description: Financial or material loss resulting from an unplanned event, which triggers incident management and reporting obligations.
context: Incident = Unplanned event causing actual loss or regulatory breach

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Breach
raw_entities.description: A violation of regulatory requirements or obligations resulting from an unplanned event, which constitutes an incident requiring management and reporting.
context: Incident = Unplanned event causing actual loss or regulatory breach
